title: Trump administration targets $4 trillion Pax Silica investment fund for semiconductors
authority_note: Trade press; in-article attribution to a New York Times report. Traces to NYT + US State Dept Pax Silica (source 129).
traced_to: New York Times report (cited in-article); US State Dept Pax Silica Initiative (source 129)
claims: Voluntary investment consortium targeting $4 trillion for energy, critical minerals, semiconductor supply chains (per NYT)
US government contributes $250 million and administers the pool
Outlined by Jacob Helberg at Hill and Valley Forum; expansion of Pax Silica (launched Dec 2025)
Founding members SoftBank, Temasek, Mubadala collectively manage > $1 trillion in combined assets
Also includes sovereign wealth funds from Singapore, UAE, Qatar, Sweden
Pax Silica now counts 13 member countries
$250M = 0.00625% of $4T goal; total global FDI last year $1.6T (UN via NYT)
